title: Uma yant’äwimp jan uñt’ayat jaqi
intro: Nayra qillqatanakan anales ukanx mä muspharkañ jaqiw utji, jupan sarnaqäwipax janiw mä jach’a milagrompi jan ukax mä qhixu qhixu uñacht’äwimp qalltkiti, jan ukasti mä sanu ukampis wali ch’ullqhi iyawsäwi yant’äwimpiw qallti. Mä markax mä cruce thakhin sayt’atäna, irpirinakjam Diosan irnaqawip thaqhasa. Kunatï paskäna ukajj wali chʼikhi yantʼänwa, ukhamatwa jupanak taypin cheqpach iyawsirinakajj qhanstayaspäna. ¿Uka misterio jaytat pʼeqeñchäwinakat amuytʼasmati?
clues: Nayax mä lineamientot jutta, jaqinakax wali askit uñjapxirïna, ukat Allah jupax mä qullan amtampiw ajlliwayitu, jupanakax janiw amuyañjamäkänti.
Cuerpojajj yaqha jaqenakan jan utjkäna uka chimpu aptʼatäjjänwa, ukatwa markaja taypin mayj mayja saytʼasiyäta.
Kunawsatix jawirax yant’äw sasin yatiyatän ukhax jilpachanix qhipäxar kutt’apxäna —ukampis nayax nayrar sartawaytwa, Allah-an arsutapar jan mayjt’ir iyawsäwimp irpata.
Janipuniw jarkʼat umat umañajatak kamachitäna, ukampis mä gotakiw lakajat qhespiwayi, uka juchajj wiñayatakiw chuymajar aynachtʼayäna.
Allah jupax mä wayna awatirimp jikisiñaw amtawayitu, jupax mä urux mä ch’aman uñisirir jiwayatapat leyendaruw tukuni.
Kunapachatï ejercitonakajj chʼajjwasipkäna ukhajja, janiw uñisirinakan amparapamp jaqontatäkti, jan ukasti Diosan kamachiparjamaw jawir jakʼan jan istʼasirïtaj laykojj mutuyatäyäta.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
